      &lt;div class=&quot;editor-header-left&quot;>
        &lt;button class=&quot;history-button&quot; type=&quot;button&quot; aria-label=&quot;Undo&quot;>Undo&lt;/button>

      &lt;button class=&quot;history-button redo-button&quot; type=&quot;button&quot; aria-label=&quot;Redo&quot;>Redo&lt;/button>
    &lt;/header>
    &lt;div class=&quot;editor-tabs&quot; role=&quot;tablist&quot; aria-label=&quot;Code languages&quot;>
      &lt;button class=&quot;editor-tab is-active&quot; id=&quot;html-tab&quot; type=&quot;button&quot; role=&quot;tab&quot; aria-selected=&quot;true&quot; aria-controls=&quot;html-editor&quot; data-language=&quot;html&quot;>HTML&lt;/button>
      &lt;button class=&quot;editor-tab&quot; id=&quot;css-tab&quot; type=&quot;button&quot; role=&quot;tab&quot; aria-selected=&quot;false&quot; aria-controls=&quot;css-editor&quot; data-language=&quot;css&quot;>CSS&lt;/button>
      &lt;button class=&quot;editor-tab&quot; id=&quot;js-tab&quot; type=&quot;button&quot; role=&quot;tab&quot; aria-selected=&quot;false&quot; aria-controls=&quot;js-editor&quot; data-language=&quot;js&quot;>JS&lt;/button>
    &lt;/div>
    &lt;div class=&quot;editor-area&quot; id=&quot;editor-area&quot;>
      &lt;div class=&quot;code-editor is-visible&quot; id=&quot;html-editor&quot; data-language=&quot;html&quot; aria-label=&quot;HTML code&quot;>&lt;/div>
      &lt;div class=&quot;code-editor&quot; id=&quot;css-editor&quot; data-language=&quot;css&quot; aria-label=&quot;CSS code&quot; hidden>&lt;/div>
      &lt;div class=&quot;code-editor&quot; id=&quot;js-editor&quot; data-language=&quot;js&quot; aria-label=&quot;JavaScript code&quot; hidden>&lt;/div>
    &lt;/div>
  &lt;/section>
  &lt;script src=&quot;https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/codemirror/5.65.16/codemirror.min.js&quot;>&lt;/script>
  &lt;script src=&quot;https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/codemirror/5.65.16/mode/xml/xml.min.js&quot;>&lt;/script>
  &lt;script src=&quot;https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/codemirror/5.65.16/mode/css/css.min.js&quot;>&lt;/script>
  &lt;script src=&quot;https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/codemirror/5.65.16/mode/javascript/javascript.min.js&quot;>&lt;/script>
  &lt;script src=&quot;https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/codemirror/5.65.16/mode/htmlmixed/htmlmixed.min.js&quot;>&lt;/script>
  &lt;script>
(() => {
  const tabs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.editor-tab'));
  const hosts = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.code-editor'));
  if (!tabs.length || !hosts.length || !window.CodeMirror) return;
  const modes = { html: 'htmlmixed', css: 'css', js: 'javascript' };
  const samples = {
    html: '&lt;!DOCTYPE html>\n&lt;html lang=&quot;en&quot;>\n&lt;head>\n  &lt;meta charset=&quot;UTF-8&quot;>\n  &lt;meta name=&quot;viewport&quot; content=&quot;width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0&quot;>\n  &lt;title>My Page&lt;/title>\n&lt;/head>\n&lt;body>\n  &lt;h1>Hello World&lt;/h1>\n  &lt;p>This is a sample page.&lt;/p>\n  &lt;button>Click me&lt;/button>\n&lt;/body>\n&lt;/html>',
    css: 'body {\n  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;\n  padding: 20px;\n}\n\nh1 {\n  color: royalblue;\n}',
    js: &quot;const button = document.querySelector('button');\n\nbutton.addEventListener('click', () => {\n  alert('Hello!');\n});&quot;
  };
  const editors = {};
  const STORAGE_KEY = 'editor-project-code-v1';
  let isResetting = false;
  function loadSavedCode() {
    try {
      const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || 'null');
      if (!saved || typeof saved !== 'object') return {};
      const restored = Object.fromEntries(
        Object.keys(samples).filter((language) => typeof saved[language] === 'string')
          .map((language) => [language, saved[language]])
      );
      if (typeof restored.html === 'string' &amp;&amp; !/&lt;html\b/i.test(restored.html)) {
        const oldSampleContent = '  &lt;h1>Hello World&lt;/h1>\n  &lt;p>This is a sample page.&lt;/p>\n  &lt;button>Click me&lt;/button>';
        restored.html = samples.html.replace(oldSampleContent, restored.html);
      }
      return restored;
    } catch (error) {
      return {};
    }
  }
  function saveCode() {
    try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(getCode())); }
    catch (error) { /* Editing remains available if browser storage is unavailable. */ }
  }
  const savedCode = loadSavedCode();
  hosts.forEach((host) => {
    const language = host.dataset.language;
    editors[language] = CodeMirror(host, {
      value: Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(savedCode, language) ? savedCode[language] : samples[language],
      mode: modes[language], theme: 'material-darker', lineNumbers: true, lineWrapping: false,
      indentUnit: 2, tabSize: 2, indentWithTabs: false, autofocus: language === 'html',
      matchBrackets: true, autoCloseBrackets: true, extraKeys: { 'Ctrl-Space': 'autocomplete' }
    });
    editors[language].on('change', () => {
      if (!isResetting) { saveCode(); sendCode(); }
    });
  });
  function getCode() {
    return { html: editors.html.getValue(), css: editors.css.getValue(), js: editors.js.getValue() };
  }
  function sendCode() {
    window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'EDITOR_CODE_UPDATE', code: getCode() }, window.location.origin);
  }
  function resetEditors() {
    isResetting = true;
    Object.keys(editors).forEach((language) => { editors[language].setValue(samples[language]); editors[language].clearHistory(); });
    isResetting = false;
    try { localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY); } catch (error) { /* Reset still completes. */ }
    sendCode();
    const activeTab = tabs.find((tab) => tab.classList.contains('is-active'));
    const activeEditor = activeTab &amp;&amp; editors[activeTab.dataset.language];
    if (activeEditor) activeEditor.focus();
  }
  function activateTab(tab) {
    tabs.forEach((item) => {
      const active = item === tab;
      item.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
      item.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(active));
      item.tabIndex = active ? 0 : -1;
    });
    hosts.forEach((host) => {
      host.hidden = host.dataset.language !== tab.dataset.language;
      host.classList.toggle('is-visible', !host.hidden);
    });
    const activeEditor = editors[tab.dataset.language];
    if (activeEditor) { activeEditor.refresh(); activeEditor.focus(); }
  }
  tabs.forEach((tab) => tab.addEventListener('click', () => activateTab(tab)));
  window.codeEditors = editors;
  window.getSelectedCode = (language) => editors[language] ? editors[language].getSelection() : '';
  window.getCodeSelectionRange = (language) => {
    const editor = editors[language];
    return editor ? { from: editor.getCursor('from'), to: editor.getCursor('to') } : null;
  };
  window.replaceSelectedCode = (language, replacement) => {
    const editor = editors[language];
    if (!editor || typeof replacement !== 'string') return false;
    editor.replaceSelection(replacement, 'around');
    editor.focus();
    return true;
  };
  window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
    if (event.source !== window.parent) return;
    if (event.data?.type === 'LIVE_PREVIEW_READY' || event.data?.type === 'REQUEST_EDITOR_CODE') sendCode();
    if (event.data?.type === 'RESET_EDITOR') resetEditors();
  });
  sendCode();
})();

&lt;/script>
&lt;/body>
&lt;/html>
"></iframe>

&lt;body>
  &lt;section class=&quot;panel preview-panel&quot; aria-labelledby=&quot;preview-title&quot;>
    &lt;header class=&quot;panel-header live-header&quot; aria-label=&quot;Live Header&quot;>
      &lt;h1 id=&quot;preview-title&quot;>Live Preview&lt;/h1>
    &lt;/header>
    &lt;div class=&quot;preview-area&quot; aria-label=&quot;Live code display area&quot;>
      &lt;iframe class=&quot;preview-frame&quot; title=&quot;Rendered code preview&quot; sandbox=&quot;allow-scripts allow-modals&quot;>&lt;/iframe>
    &lt;/div>
  &lt;/section>
  &lt;script>
(() => {
  const previewFrame = document.querySelector('.preview-frame');
  if (!previewFrame) return;
  const renderPreview = (code) => {
    if (!code || typeof code !== 'object') return;
    const html = typeof code.html === 'string' ? code.html : '';
    const css = typeof code.css === 'string' ? code.css : '';
    const js = typeof code.js === 'string' ? code.js : '';
    const hasDoctype = /^\s*&lt;!doctype\s+html\s*>/i.test(html);
    const hasHtml = /&lt;html\b[^>]*>/i.test(html);
    const hasHead = /&lt;head\b[^>]*>/i.test(html);
    const hasBody = /&lt;body\b[^>]*>/i.test(html);
    if (!hasDoctype || !hasHtml || !hasHead || !hasBody) {
      previewFrame.srcdoc = '&lt;!DOCTYPE html>&lt;html lang=&quot;en&quot;>&lt;head>&lt;meta charset=&quot;UTF-8&quot;>&lt;title>Invalid HTML Document&lt;/title>&lt;/head>&lt;body>&lt;p style=&quot;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;padding:20px;color:#b91c1c&quot;>The HTML editor must contain &lt;!DOCTYPE html>, &lt;html>, &lt;head>, and &lt;body> tags.&lt;/p>&lt;/body>&lt;/html>';
      return;
    }
    const parsed = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
    if (css.trim()) {
      const style = parsed.createElement('style');
      style.textContent = css;
      parsed.head.appendChild(style);
    }
    if (js.trim()) {
      const script = parsed.createElement('script');
      script.textContent = js;
      parsed.body.appendChild(script);
    }
    previewFrame.srcdoc = '&lt;!DOCTYPE html>\n' + parsed.documentElement.outerHTML;
  };
  window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
    if (event.source !== window.parent || event.data?.type !== 'EDITOR_CODE_UPDATE') return;
    renderPreview(event.data.code);
  });
  window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'LIVE_PREVIEW_READY' }, '*');
})();

&lt;/script>
&lt;/body>
&lt;/html>
"></iframe>

&lt;body>
  &lt;div class=&quot;download-overlay&quot; hidden>
    &lt;section class=&quot;download-dialog&quot; role=&quot;dialog&quot; aria-modal=&quot;true&quot; aria-labelledby=&quot;download-title&quot;>
      &lt;header class=&quot;dialog-header&quot;>
        &lt;h2 id=&quot;download-title&quot;>Download&lt;/h2>
        &lt;button class=&quot;icon-button close-button&quot; type=&quot;button&quot; aria-label=&quot;Close&quot;>×&lt;/button>
      &lt;/header>
      &lt;p class=&quot;dialog-description&quot;>Choose how you want to download your project.&lt;/p>
      &lt;div class=&quot;method-list&quot;>
        &lt;label class=&quot;method-option&quot;>
          &lt;input type=&quot;radio&quot; name=&quot;download-method&quot; value=&quot;single&quot; checked>
          &lt;span class=&quot;method-copy&quot;>&lt;strong>Single HTML file&lt;/strong>&lt;small>Combine HTML, CSS and JavaScript into one standalone HTML file.&lt;/small>&lt;/span>
        &lt;/label>
        &lt;label class=&quot;method-option&quot;>
          &lt;input type=&quot;radio&quot; name=&quot;download-method&quot; value=&quot;individual&quot;>
          &lt;span class=&quot;method-copy&quot;>&lt;strong>Individual files&lt;/strong>&lt;small>Download selected files separately.&lt;/small>&lt;/span>
        &lt;/label>
      &lt;/div>
      &lt;div class=&quot;file-options&quot; hidden>
        &lt;label class=&quot;file-choice&quot;>&lt;input type=&quot;checkbox&quot; value=&quot;html&quot; checked> HTML&lt;/label>
        &lt;label class=&quot;file-choice&quot;>&lt;input type=&quot;checkbox&quot; value=&quot;css&quot; checked> CSS&lt;/label>
        &lt;label class=&quot;file-choice&quot;>&lt;input type=&quot;checkbox&quot; value=&quot;js&quot; checked> JS&lt;/label>
      &lt;/div>
      &lt;div class=&quot;name-fields&quot;>
        &lt;label class=&quot;field-label&quot; for=&quot;single-filename&quot;>File name&lt;/label>
        &lt;input class=&quot;text-field&quot; id=&quot;single-filename&quot; value=&quot;index.html&quot; autocomplete=&quot;off&quot;>
        &lt;div class=&quot;individual-names&quot; hidden>
          &lt;label class=&quot;field-label&quot; for=&quot;html-filename&quot;>HTML file name&lt;/label>
          &lt;input class=&quot;text-field&quot; id=&quot;html-filename&quot; value=&quot;index.html&quot; autocomplete=&quot;off&quot;>
          &lt;label class=&quot;field-label&quot; for=&quot;css-filename&quot;>CSS file name&lt;/label>
          &lt;input class=&quot;text-field&quot; id=&quot;css-filename&quot; value=&quot;style.css&quot; autocomplete=&quot;off&quot;>
          &lt;label class=&quot;field-label&quot; for=&quot;js-filename&quot;>JavaScript file name&lt;/label>
          &lt;input class=&quot;text-field&quot; id=&quot;js-filename&quot; value=&quot;script.js&quot; autocomplete=&quot;off&quot;>
        &lt;/div>
      &lt;/div>
      &lt;div class=&quot;location-row&quot;>
        &lt;div>&lt;strong>Save location&lt;/strong>&lt;small class=&quot;location-status&quot;>Not selected&lt;/small>&lt;/div>
        &lt;button class=&quot;secondary-button choose-location&quot; type=&quot;button&quot;>Choose location&lt;/button>
      &lt;/div>
      &lt;p class=&quot;error-message&quot; role=&quot;alert&quot; hidden>&lt;/p>
      &lt;footer class=&quot;dialog-actions&quot;>
        &lt;button class=&quot;secondary-button cancel-button&quot; type=&quot;button&quot;>Cancel&lt;/button>
        &lt;button class=&quot;primary-button download-button&quot; type=&quot;button&quot;>Download&lt;/button>
      &lt;/footer>
    &lt;/section>
  &lt;/div>
  &lt;script>
(() => {
  const overlay = document.querySelector('.download-overlay');
  const closeButton = document.querySelector('.close-button');
  const cancelButton = document.querySelector('.cancel-button');
  const downloadButton = document.querySelector('.download-button');
  const chooseLocationButton = document.querySelector('.choose-location');
  const methodInputs = [...document.querySelectorAll('input[name=&quot;download-method&quot;]')];
  const fileOptions = document.querySelector('.file-options');
  const singleFilename = document.querySelector('#single-filename');
  const individualNames = document.querySelector('.individual-names');
  const locationStatus = document.querySelector('.location-status');
  const errorMessage = document.querySelector('.error-message');
  let currentCode = null;
  let directoryHandle = null;

  const method = () => methodInputs.find((input) => input.checked)?.value || 'single';
  const selectedFiles = () => [...document.querySelectorAll('.file-choice input:checked')].map((input) => input.value);
  const showError = (message) => { errorMessage.textContent = message; errorMessage.hidden = false; };
  const clearError = () => { errorMessage.textContent = ''; errorMessage.hidden = true; };
  const openDialog = () => {
    overlay.hidden = false;
    directoryHandle = null;
    locationStatus.textContent = 'Not selected';
    clearError();
    window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'DOWNLOAD_CODE_REQUEST' }, '*');
    closeButton.focus();
  };
  const closeDialog = () => {
    overlay.hidden = true;
    directoryHandle = null;
    window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'DOWNLOAD_DIALOG_CLOSED' }, '*');
  };
  const updateMethod = () => {
    const individual = method() === 'individual';
    fileOptions.hidden = !individual;
    singleFilename.parentElement.querySelector('.field-label').hidden = individual;
    singleFilename.hidden = individual;
    individualNames.hidden = !individual;
  };
  methodInputs.forEach((input) => input.addEventListener('change', updateMethod));
  closeButton.addEventListener('click', closeDialog);
  cancelButton.addEventListener('click', closeDialog);
  overlay.addEventListener('click', (event) => { if (event.target === overlay) closeDialog(); });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => { if (event.key === 'Escape' &amp;&amp; !overlay.hidden) closeDialog(); });

  const makeStandaloneHtml = (code) => {
    const html = code.html || '';
    if (!/^\s*&lt;!doctype\s+html\s*>/i.test(html) || !/&lt;html\b/i.test(html) || !/&lt;head\b/i.test(html) || !/&lt;body\b/i.test(html)) {
      throw new Error('The HTML editor must contain &lt;!DOCTYPE html>, &lt;html>, &lt;head> and &lt;body> tags.');
    }
    const parsed = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
    if (code.css?.trim()) {
      const style = parsed.createElement('style');
      style.textContent = code.css;
      parsed.head.appendChild(style);
    }
    if (code.js?.trim()) {
      const script = parsed.createElement('script');
      script.textContent = code.js;
      parsed.body.appendChild(script);
    }
    return '&lt;!DOCTYPE html>\n' + parsed.documentElement.outerHTML;
  };
  const normalizeFilename = (value, extension) => {
    let name = value.trim().replace(/[\\/:*?&quot;&lt;>|]/g, '-');
    if (!name) throw new Error('Enter a file name.');
    if (!name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.' + extension)) name += '.' + extension;
    return name;
  };
  const getFiles = () => {
    if (!currentCode) throw new Error('Project code is not ready yet. Please try again.');
    if (method() === 'single') return [{ name: normalizeFilename(singleFilename.value, 'html'), content: makeStandaloneHtml(currentCode) }];
    const chosen = selectedFiles();
    if (!chosen.length) throw new Error('Select at least one file.');
    const config = {
      html: ['html-filename', 'html', currentCode.html || ''],
      css: ['css-filename', 'css', currentCode.css || ''],
      js: ['js-filename', 'js', currentCode.js || '']
    };
    return chosen.map((key) => {
      const [inputId, extension, content] = config[key];
      return { name: normalizeFilename(document.getElementById(inputId).value, extension), content };
    });
  };
  chooseLocationButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    clearError();
    try {
      const pickerWindow = window.parent;
      if (!pickerWindow.showDirectoryPicker) throw new Error('Folder selection is not supported in this browser. You can still download using the browser save option.');
      directoryHandle = await pickerWindow.showDirectoryPicker({ mode: 'readwrite' });
      locationStatus.textContent = 'Folder selected';
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.name !== 'AbortError') showError(error.message);
    }
  });
  const saveWithDirectory = async (files) => {
    for (const file of files) {
      const handle = await directoryHandle.getFileHandle(file.name, { create: true });
      const writable = await handle.createWritable();
      await writable.write(file.content);
      await writable.close();
    }
  };
  const saveWithBrowser = async (files) => {
    const pickerWindow = window.parent;
    if (files.length === 1 &amp;&amp; pickerWindow.showSaveFilePicker) {
      const file = files[0];
      const extension = file.name.split('.').pop();
      const mime = extension === 'html' ? 'text/html' : extension === 'css' ? 'text/css' : 'text/javascript';
      const handle = await pickerWindow.showSaveFilePicker({ suggestedName: file.name, types: [{ description: 'Project file', accept: { [mime]: ['.' + extension] } }] });
      const writable = await handle.createWritable();
      await writable.write(file.content);
      await writable.close();
      return;
    }
    files.forEach((file) => {
      const extension = file.name.split('.').pop();
      const mime = extension === 'html' ? 'text/html' : extension === 'css' ? 'text/css' : 'text/javascript';
      const blob = new Blob([file.content], { type: mime });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const anchor = document.createElement('a');
      anchor.href = url;
      anchor.download = file.name;
      document.body.appendChild(anchor);
      anchor.click();
      anchor.remove();
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
    });
  };
  downloadButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    clearError();
    try {
      const files = getFiles();
      if (directoryHandle) await saveWithDirectory(files);
      else await saveWithBrowser(files);
      closeDialog();
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.name !== 'AbortError') showError(error.message);
    }
  });
  window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
    if (event.source !== window.parent) return;
    if (event.data?.type === 'OPEN_DOWNLOAD_DIALOG') openDialog();
    if (event.data?.type === 'DOWNLOAD_CODE_UPDATE') currentCode = event.data.code;
  });
  updateMethod();
  window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'DOWNLOAD_COMPONENT_READY' }, '*');
})();
&lt;/script>
&lt;/body>
&lt;/html>
"></iframe>
  <footer class="site-footer" aria-label="Footer"></footer>

  <script>
(() => {
  const workspace = document.querySelector('.workspace');
  const splitter = document.querySelector('.splitter');
  const editorFrame = document.querySelector('iframe[src="sections/editor/index.html"]');
  const liveFrame = document.querySelector('iframe[src="sections/live/index.html"]');
  const resetFrame = document.querySelector('iframe[src="sections/reset/index.html"]');
  const downloadFrame = document.querySelector('.download-frame');
  const downloadButton = document.querySelector('[aria-label="Download"]');
  if (!workspace || !splitter) return;

  let dragging = false;
  let latestCode = null;

  const requestCodeFromEditor = () => editorFrame?.contentWindow?.postMessage({ type: 'REQUEST_EDITOR_CODE' }, '*');
  const sendCodeToPreview = () => {
    if (latestCode && liveFrame?.contentWindow) liveFrame.contentWindow.postMessage({ type: 'EDITOR_CODE_UPDATE', code: latestCode }, '*');
  };
  const sendCodeToDownload = () => {
    if (latestCode && downloadFrame?.contentWindow) downloadFrame.contentWindow.postMessage({ type: 'DOWNLOAD_CODE_UPDATE', code: latestCode }, '*');
  };

  downloadButton?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    downloadFrame?.classList.add('is-open');
    downloadFrame?.contentWindow?.postMessage({ type: 'OPEN_DOWNLOAD_DIALOG' }, '*');
    requestCodeFromEditor();
  });

  window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
    if (event.source === resetFrame?.contentWindow && event.data?.type === 'RESET_EDITOR_REQUEST') {
      editorFrame?.contentWindow?.postMessage({ type: 'RESET_EDITOR' }, '*');
      return;
    }
    if (event.source === downloadFrame?.contentWindow && event.data?.type === 'DOWNLOAD_DIALOG_CLOSED') {
      downloadFrame.classList.remove('is-open');
      return;
    }
    if (event.source === downloadFrame?.contentWindow && event.data?.type === 'DOWNLOAD_CODE_REQUEST') {
      requestCodeFromEditor();
      sendCodeToDownload();
      return;
    }
    if (event.source === liveFrame?.contentWindow && event.data?.type === 'LIVE_PREVIEW_READY') {
      requestCodeFromEditor();
      sendCodeToPreview();
      return;
    }
    if (event.source !== editorFrame?.contentWindow || event.data?.type !== 'EDITOR_CODE_UPDATE') return;
    latestCode = event.data.code;
    sendCodeToPreview();
    sendCodeToDownload();
  });

  editorFrame?.addEventListener('load', requestCodeFromEditor);
  liveFrame?.addEventListener('load', () => { requestCodeFromEditor(); sendCodeToPreview(); });
  downloadFrame?.addEventListener('load', sendCodeToDownload);

  const resize = (clientX) => {
    const bounds = workspace.getBoundingClientRect();
    const position = ((clientX - bounds.left) / bounds.width) * 100;
    const value = Math.min(75, Math.max(25, position));
    workspace.style.setProperty('--split', value + '%');
    splitter.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(Math.round(value)));
  };
  splitter.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
    dragging = true;
    splitter.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    document.body.classList.add('is-resizing');
    resize(event.clientX);
  });
  splitter.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => { if (dragging) resize(event.clientX); });
  const stopDragging = () => { dragging = false; document.body.classList.remove('is-resizing'); };
  splitter.addEventListener('pointerup', stopDragging);
  splitter.addEventListener('pointercancel', stopDragging);
  splitter.addEventListener('lostpointercapture', stopDragging);
  splitter.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
    if (event.key !== 'ArrowLeft' && event.key !== 'ArrowRight') return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const current = Number(splitter.getAttribute('aria-valuenow')) || 50;
    const next = Math.min(75, Math.max(25, current + (event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 2 : -2)));
    workspace.style.setProperty('--split', next + '%');
    splitter.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(next));
  });
})();

</script>
</body>
</html>
